doc: T3 provider instances from orchestrator_capabilities. bin/lint-config fails a Model routing row in AGENTS.md that names a disabled instance or a model outside the allowlist, so a settings change cannot leave a dead band behind. 'routableModels' is a curated allowlist of what the table may pin, not the full catalog. Re-verify with orchestrator_capabilities and move 'verified' in the same change. 2026-11-04: re-verified against the live catalog; the curated allowlist is deliberately unchanged.

opencode.note: One instance multiplexes the OpenCode Go plan and the xAI/Claude subscriptions: xai/* draws the xAI login, claude-agent/* the Claude Code login, opencode-go/* the Go plan.

claudeAgent.reason: Provider instance is disabled; claude-agent/sonnet on opencode replaces it.

grok.reason: Provider instance is disabled; xai/grok-4.7 on opencode replaces it. grok-4.7-build-fast exists only here.
